Gideon, I posted the draft as a reply in your thread here.

- First reported: 10:42 AM on Aug 3, when both gate kiosks went offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant.
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM, when the guard checked in trailer 8836.
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM.

The draft also notes that Kiosk 2 was kept powered on for reconnect attempts, and that Mateo's status-page access is still open under INC-4821.

I took the times from #inc-vtg-hartford, which you, Ruth, Nadia and Mateo can see. Your 10:47 AM email to procurement is not in that channel, so I didn't check it against the draft.
